amendments.title: Consolidate RULE 6 + RULE 10 → Single EW Completeness Rule
keyArguments: RULE 6 (DL-026) and RULE 10 (DL-021) catch fundamentally different defect classes: absent field vs present-but-empty field
Root causes differ: DL-021 = extractor/schema gap; DL-026 = content-authoring gap where writer left placeholder
Audit trail value: distinguishing 'field missing entirely' vs 'field present but empty' enables targeted remediation and forensic traceability
Consolidation loses diagnostic precision — a single rule cannot differentiate the two failure modes in violation reports
Rule count reduction is not a valid governance objective; clarity and auditability trump brevity
amendments.dissentingOpinion: None — unanimous that diagnostic separation provides operational value

amendments.title: Add RULE 22 — Evidence-Basis Traceability
keyArguments: DL-045 doctrine (screen output is evidence, not an author) should be codified for certification-impacting changes
RULE 17 already covers mass rewrites (≥3 objects) — RULE 22 should extend evidence-basis requirement to certification state changes and answer-key modifications, not all single-item editorial fixes

Proposed modification: Require evidence-basis citation for (a) any question_state transition to/from Certified, (b) CorrectChoice/Correct changes, (c) ExplanationCorrect/ExplanationWrong rewrites on Certified items. Exempt: metadata-only fixes, formatting, typo corrections on non-Certified items
Overhead concern valid for pure editorial velocity; scope limitation preserves DL-045 intent without burdening routine cleanup
amendments.dissentingOpinion: Minority view: evidence basis should be required for ALL content changes to build complete audit trail; exemptions create loopholes

amendments.title: Add RULE 23 — Delivery Pool Integrity Continuous Check
keyArguments: probe:parity (npm run probe:parity) already provides comprehensive delivery pool validation: Certified-only filter, blocklist enforcement, quarantined ID exclusion, per-validator coverage
Preflight (npm run preflight) runs at T0 for Full Governance Lane; probe:parity runs at Tend — adding a 'lightweight' duplicate creates maintenance burden and divergence risk
If T0 delivery-pool check is desired, the correct path is to make probe:parity a mandatory preflight step (update package.json pipeline), not create a new rule with parallel implementation
Rule 21 (semantic quarantine manifest) already blocks Certified flips for quarantined QIDs — delivery pool integrity is gatekept at certification, not runtime
amendments.dissentingOpinion: One member favors MODIFY: integrate probe:parity into preflight as mandatory step rather than new rule; achieves same continuous assurance without rule proliferation

nextSteps: Amendment B to be redrafted with scoped evidence-basis requirement (certification/answer-key/explanation changes on Certified items only)
Amendment C concern addressed by updating preflight to require probe:parity at T0 (package.json change, not new rule)
Amendment A remains rejected — no further action
